items.summary: 07.03.02's 'Bands as invitees' block said band-entity acceptance yields 'one negotiation and four credits' and attributed that to parent Q-03, which states the exact opposite. Rewrote the block to state D-10's ratified rule — one section credit, no fan-out — with D-11 for the access half.

items.classificationRationale: One side is the numbered decision in the file that owns the concept (07.03.01 D-10, explicitly marked 'Resolves Q-03 / parent Q-03', sourced to ratified 02.01.01 D-07 and 02.06 D-21) and restated consistently at :167 and in the parent index Q-03. The other side is a single prose paragraph in a sibling feature file that not only contradicts it but misattributes its inverted rule to the very decision that forbids it. Textbook drift, not a live product question — the tree decided this and the sibling was missed.
